segments: Fish 4.x: an intelligent shell with syntax highlighting, completion, and history suggestions out of the box. It uses Emacs key bindings by default, with an optional vi mode. These shortcuts are compiled from Fish 4.x notes; terminals and custom bindings may override the defaults. Check them with bind and fish_key_reader.
Real-time coloring as you type: valid commands in blue, invalid commands in red, paths underlined, and quotes in yellow
Gray text suggests matching commands from history; press → or Ctrl+f to accept
A navigable, searchable menu of completions
Type an abbreviation → press Space to expand it automatically into the full command
Use fish_config to choose themes and change the prompt in a browser
